question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "borrow".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"borrow"** means to take something temporarily with the intention of returning it after use. (उधार लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **Can I borrow your pen for a moment?
 

 
• **"Lend" **means to give something temporarily to someone with the expectation of it being returned. It is the opposite of "borrow". (उधार देना)

 
 
• **Example: **I will lend you my car for the weekend.
